scope: Four prior remote-endpoint tests, approved as shown before any production change. test_definitions: the five origins that become valid (plain HTTP, an IPv4 address, a bracketed IPv6 address, a non-default port and a single-label name) leave the refusal list, and the test is renamed test_non_canonical_origins_are_refused. test_reader: its invalid origin becomes ftp://private-host.example, since http:// is now valid. test_plugin: register_models returns the declared model entry instead of an empty list. test_app_regressions: the configured app's provider listing is compared with the bundled app's on the bundled providers' rows only, since a granted account now also sees its endpoints. After review, approved as shown on 2026-10-23: test_provider_access_availability_route checks the pending status on the registered gemini-cli instead of the unregistered gemini, expects rows for the registered providers only, and gains test_a_pair_of_an_unregistered_provider_has_no_row. After the third review, approved as shown on 2026-10-27: the gateway_modules fixture of the SDK's test_cache_local stands in an empty aigateway.provider_composition module beside the other four, and its docstring says five. Approved as shown on 2026-10-27, docstrings only: test_app_access says a denied endpoint adds no signal at these entry points and hides it from the working catalog, not its existence, as the community cache shares endpoint IDs and answers on purpose; test_app_cache_order explains its test-only projection without the stale CacheBypass claim. After the fifth review, approved as shown on 2026-10-28: the fake upstream in the remote_endpoint conftest encodes its echo in base64 and echo_of decodes it, since an answer holding the caller's key is never stored and the general cache tests need a cacheable one; literal reflection is covered by a new test. Also approved then, on a file this branch adds: test_a_cancelled_shutdown_still_closes_every_endpoint patches the close drain bound to 0.05 s and its poll comment says the sweep gave up at its bound. Nothing else changes.
reason: Hosted BYOM Unit 1 (owner decisions of 2026-10-22): approved HTTP, IP and port origins, a catalog filtered by the account grants, the shared chat cache and a reused client per endpoint. The owner chose on 2026-10-23 that the availability listing shows only registered providers the caller may see, so a removed endpoint's stored pair gets no row. The SDK's revisions for a cache pull now also import the composition module, which registers the configured-endpoint revision; the SDK test job has no gateway runtime to import it from. The owner decided on 2026-10-27 that the community cache lists published entries of configured endpoints to every authenticated account with no grant filter, so a promise that an ungranted tenant cannot learn of an endpoint was too broad. Each edit follows from a contract the owner changed on purpose.
